package.name: parking_vision_ros
package.description: ROS 2 components for Pinky's parking alignment: ParkingVisionNode judges it from a ceiling camera image topic (display-only /pinky_parking/state and the /pinky_parking/check service), and CeilingCameraNode captures that camera read-only and publishes /ceiling_camera/image_raw and its compressed JPEG. Observation only; sends no robot command.
